# The directory and newNonce can be fetched without authentication.
# The harness fetches it before the first case; this fetches it again.

GET $dirURL
$body.newNonce ~ ^https://
$body.newAccount ~ ^https://
$body.keyChange ~ ^https://
$body.revokeCert !exists
$body.newAccount == $dir.newAccount
$body.keyChange == $dir.keyChange

HEAD $dirURL
$header.Content-Type == application/json

POST $dir.newAccount
payload {}
$code == 201

# POST-as-GET works for the directory too.
POST-as-GET $dirURL
$body.newAccount == $dir.newAccount

POST-as-GET $dir.newNonce
$code == 200

# A directory request must not carry a payload.
POST $dirURL
payload {}
error == malformed
